The '''Imperial Heavy Repulsortank''' was a model of [[heavy repulsortank]] employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was armed with a single turret-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|heavy laser cannon]], a [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]], and two [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blasters]]. One of the repulsortanks was deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]], where it guarded a convoy of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and [[Imperial patrol landspeeder]]s that was attacked by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives in conjunction with local outlaws commanded by [[Scruts]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Heavy Repulsortank should not be confused with the ''[[Imperial-class 1-H repulsortank/Legends|Imperial-class 1-H repulsortank]]'', a vehicle that was created for ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'' and whose design differs slightly.
